description: Whether one extension may run one server method, or every method of one app, for one installation. The user answers in the Builder editor, not here. A method runs as the user, so it can change anything the user can change. Set the answer to not asked, or delete the grant, to let the extension ask again.

fields.description: The installation this grant belongs to. It identifies the user, the source, and the extension.
fields.label: Installation

fields.description: method: one method. app: every method of one app.
fields.label: Scope

fields.description: A dotted path such as myapp.api.export, a doctype method such as Form.get_summary, or an app name.
fields.label: Target

name: Builder Extension Method Grant
